- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30
- Thu: none (09:00–17:00 fully booked)
- Fri: none (09:00–17:00 fully booked)

So if the meeting can be 30 minutes, or if we can run slightly into an adjacent block, any of those gaps would work. Otherwise I'm happy to move one of my own commitments (e.g. a Focus block) to open a full hour — just tell me the day and time you and the others prefer and I'll do my best to make it fit.

Note I keep to 09:00–17:00, so nothing outside those hours on my side.
